subject: Bench SDK S1: client.py — unified stdlib HTTP lifecycle
description: bench/zonoid_bench/client.py — the ONE Zonoid HTTP client (stdlib urllib; supersedes both zonoid_lifecycle.py [urllib] and zonoid_memory.py [requests, won't run here]). Methods: post_note(no force), search(tiered, gated, query-string), post_verdict(wrapped {verdicts:[...]}), get_task_context, post_status, task_suggest (GET /task/suggest — suggest_links, returns ceScore), overlay_edge (POST /overlay/edge), warm_up. Encode the 6 load-bearing daemon findings AS CODE (absolute-workspace assert, drop force, GET query-string, wrapped verdicts, embedder warm-up, the structBoost/createEdge note). Workspace targeting baked in (GET ?workspace, POST body.workspace). stdlib-only, runs on embeddable py312embed. Reuse the shapes already proven in zonoid_lifecycle.py + zonoid_memory.py + FeatureBench claude_code.py (_zonoid_get/_zonoid_post, /task/suggest, /overlay/edge). Unit test against the live bench daemon or a recorded shape. Commit on the attempt branch.
